# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of Oli (desktop and Android) receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report privately through GitHub:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/CyttoRak-J/Oli/security/advisories/new)

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, the affected version and platform, and the potential
impact. You can expect an acknowledgement within about a week, and updates as the fix progresses.
Once a fix is released, the issue may be disclosed publicly with credit to the reporter if wanted.

## Scope notes

Oli stores your library locally and has no account system. Builds are currently not code-signed,
so OS warnings on first launch are expected and are not vulnerabilities.
